openingLetter:
Some things don't need a special occasion.

Sometimes, you just want to make something for someone and let them know they're appreciated.
scrapbookIntroHeading: Tap any photograph to hold it a little closer.
mainReflection:
It's funny how certain people slowly become a part of your everyday life.

You don't necessarily notice it happening. You just get used to talking to them, sharing things, laughing at random nonsense, and having them around.

And eventually, you realize that their presence has become something you genuinely appreciate.
secondNote: Half of our best memories are just ordinary afternoons that turned into three-hour conversations about nothing at all. Somehow those are always the ones that stick.
collageHeading: Some moments are better kept than explained.
hiddenFlowerNote: glad our paths crossed when they did.
hiddenEnvelopeNote: P.S. Thank you for always listening to my completely unnecessary 20-minute stories like they actually matter.
endingLines: I'm genuinely glad you're my friend.
I just wanted to make something a little different for you.
I hope it made you smile.
endingSignOff: A little friendship. A little happiness. ♡
